MSMetaEnhancer is a tool used for .msp files annotation.
MSMetaEnhancer adds metadata like SMILES, InChI, and CAS number to files.
MSMetaEnhancer fetches metadata from CIR, CTS, PubChem, IDSM, and BridgeDb services.
MSMetaEnhancer uses asynchronous implementation of annotation process allowing for optimal fetching speed.
The citation for MSMetaEnhancer is Troják et al., (2022).
MSMetaEnhancer has a modular architecture that makes it easy to add new conversion services.
There are two main types of converters in MSMetaEnhancer: Web Converters and Compute Converters.
Web Converters are services that make HTTP requests to external APIs.
Compute Converters are services that perform local computations.
Converter is an abstract base class for all converters in MSMetaEnhancer.
WebConverter is a base class for web-based API services in MSMetaEnhancer.
ComputeConverter is a base class for local computation services in MSMetaEnhancer.
Job represents a conversion task defined as source attribute to target attribute using specific converter.
Converter Builder automatically discovers and instantiates available converters.
Converters automatically generate methods like compound_name_to_inchi() based on conversions list.

Web converters should be created in MSMetaEnhancer/libs/converters/web/ directory. Web converters should be registered in MSMetaEnhancer/libs/converters/web/__init__.py file. Compute converters should
Converters should define endpoints as a dictionary in their __init__ method.
Converters should define conversions as tuples of source attribute, target attribute, and conversion method.
Web converters should use Throttler for rate limiting if needed. Developers can use Throttler class for rate limiting in converters.
Compute converters should use asynch=False when creating conversion methods.
Converter developers should always handle API errors gracefully and return empty dictionaries when data is not available.
Converter developers should respect API rate limits using throttling mechanisms.
Converter developers should validate input data before making API calls.
Converter developers should implement robust response parsing that handles various response formats.
Converter developers should include docstrings for all methods explaining parameters and return values.
Converter developers should write comprehensive tests including service availability and conversion functionality.
Developers should run pytest tests/ to ensure they haven't broken existing tests.
Developers can use @lru_cache decorator for caching responses in converters.
Developers can use @escape_single_quotes decorator for input sanitization in converters.
CTS or PubChem converters serve as reference implementations for Web Converter Template.
RDKit converter serves as a reference implementation for Compute Converter Template.
The Application class serves as a top-level interface to use MSMetaEnhancer tool.
The main method of Application class is asynchronous annotate_spectra method.
annotate_spectra method runs annotation process using given conversions.
It is possible to specify particular conversion jobs in annotate_spectra which will be executed in respecting the given order.
If no jobs are given to annotate_spectra, all jobs supported by given services are used.
Application class allows loading and saving spectra files in supported formats.
Application class allows curation of given spectra.
